scientific_intent.scientific_task: Advance a low-Mach moving-wall cavity with the source D3Q19 BGK lattice Boltzmann discretization
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Periodic-addressed pull streaming with local bounce-back and moving-wall corrections, followed by density/momentum moments and BGK relaxation toward second-order equilibrium; boundary obstacle cells retain initialized populations.
scientific_intent.discretization: 17³ grid including boundary cells,15³ active fluid cells;19 populations/cell;20 timesteps from rest; moving zmin lid velocity Float32(.02), other faces bounce; source Re100 omega formula. out_u=true each step.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Full current/previous population buffers and actual u_star compared with independent generic velocity-vector CPU formulation using atol1e-7+rtol1e-6*abs(ref), declared before trials. All112 guards, immutable rho and full boundary metadata exact; actual initial GPU state prefix byte-identical. Positive populations and active mass relative drift<1e-6 independently checked.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: 4913 lattice cells,3375 active cells,20-step transient; not steady-state/grid-converged validation or source2000-step CLI performance.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float64 populations/rho coexist with Float32 macroscopic velocity and Float32 equilibrium subexpressions. The independent mathematical vector equilibrium differs slightly from optimized source mixed-precision algebra; absolute errors near zeros matter and huge raw relative-only errors must not imply global inaccuracy or be hidden.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Lattice Boltzmann collision/streaming is a computational fluid dynamics component. This is a source-backed transient cavity operator study, not a validated application-scale flow prediction.
scientific_intent.description: Source STLBM uses unrolled D3Q19 streaming, local boundary treatment and mixed precision. Historical Julia entrypoint aliases unrelated mcpr and is archived. A new genuine solver-core reference is authored. Conditional native initialization defines boundary direction bitsets before original OR operations; original GPU bodies remain unchanged.
scientific_intent.provenance: STLBM University of Geneva2020, Latt/Coreixas/Beny (bundled license/source). Native setup allocated boundary_values/dirs without initialization; explicit zero seeding is justified by bitset/field meaning, separately recorded before first trial. No undefined native run or full physical continuum correctness is claimed.
